en: Black-and-white postcard view of a large, multi-storey building with a steep tiled roof, dormer windows, and a small onion-domed turret. The facade carries the inscription "ST. LORENZHEIM". The structure is surrounded by trees, a stone wall, and a metal gate in the foreground. At the bottom left of the image, white text reads "GRAZ.  ST. LORENZHEIM" and there is a small photographer/printer credit at the bottom right.
